The ticket is #8841. I've replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random.

Tobias posted it there on Oct 13 at 09:27. He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on ticket #8841 for support.

One caveat: Tobias didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. He and Hollis called it "Tobias's dealer account." I linked the two through the Central handoff digest from January, which lists Marrow Fieldworks as Pree's dealer account and says it changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. So it's very likely the same account, but I told Pree to check with Tobias if she needs to be sure. I also warned her not to confuse it with #88412, the Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 scanner ticket.

I only used the two Central channels Pree belongs to and the public files.
